name: dsh-orch-lite
description: Agent preset that keeps the main session orchestrating: one continuable agent per feature branch, each owning a git work area (.worktrees/<feature_id>) allocated by the orch_tool work-area tool; one-shot explore agents for wide read-only sweeps; a lazy git-repository bootstrap when a write task lands in a fresh folder. The gate denies the main session exactly two things — writes inside a worker lane, and shell commands whose effects leave the repository (push, publish, gh) — and validates only dispatch packages that declare a feature_id. The two manuals and the tool are published globally, so every preset can use them; the enforcement (protocol section, worker hint, gate) stays scoped to this preset.
author: LIN_YU_JIAN <linyujian1561@outlook.com>
